note: What a server sends to say which champion a seat is playing, while the match is being put together.

fields.name: player
fields.note: The player this is about. It has a player identifier's width. In every capture its values equal the seat numbers, because the stand-in players there are numbered the same way, so the values alone do not tell the two apart.

fields.name: assetLength
fields.note: How many bytes the name below occupies, counting the byte that ends it.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The name the client loads the champion's art and sound under. It is not padded.

fields.name: terminator
fields.note: A zero byte closing the text, which the length above counts.
